passages.title: The Quarantine of Stratholme
passages.text: If the plague expedition chooses quarantine, Stratholme is contained rather than condemned to an immediate purge. The commander commits to saving the kingdom by holding the infection within its walls.
passages.heading: The Quarantine of Stratholme

deeper.title: The Roads Beyond
deeper.text: A cordon would bind the city’s fate to its guards, its stores and the discipline of those confined within. The Crown would have to sustain a siege against its own afflicted people while keeping soldiers ready for the undead beyond.
deeper.heading: The Quarantine of Stratholme — The Roads Beyond
